p9_b0.ocr: In the Asia-Pacific region for the certification exams conducted by Chegg Inc in January 2024, the overall performance exhibited a pass rate of 82% with a total of 28,000 candidates; 23,140 of these candidates passed, generating a revenue of ¥6,150M, representing a year-over-year change of 19%, and a market share of 60%.

p9_b1.ocr: Specifically, CertificationA had a pass rate of 85% with 10,000 candidates, where 8,500 passed, contributing ¥1,500M in revenue with a 5% year-over-year change and 20% market share; CertificationB recorded a pass rate of 78% from 8,000 candidates, resulting in 6,240 passing, yielding ¥1,200M with a 15% year-over-year change. CertificationC achieved a pass rate of 90% with 6,000 candidates, where 5,400 passed, generating ¥1,000M in revenue with a 10% year-over-year change; CertificationD had a pass rate of 75%, with 4,000 candidates, 3,000 passing, and revenue of ¥800M, reflecting a 3% year-over-year change.
